comment: The rebrand contract. Phase 2's rewriter MUST consult shouldRewrite(path, fieldPointer) before touching anything; a match here means the bytes carry an upstream author's attribution and a bulk replacement would destroy it (PITFALLS P-02). Every glob is matched case-insensitively over 'vendor/<tree>/<path>', with '-' and '_' treated as equivalent.

globs.reason: MIT permission text and the copyright holder line
attribution notice shipped beside a licence
bare copyright statement as its own file (defensive: no imported tree ships one today)
GPL-style licence file name (defensive: no imported tree ships one today)
third-party notices, underscore spelling; '-' and '_' are equivalent so this also covers oh-my-pi's THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt
third-party notices, hyphen spelling — the one oh-my-pi actually ships

paths_never_written.reason: the ledger records upstream bytes; a rebrand pass rewriting it would destroy the evidence it exists to hold (DEC-05)
